t: The DEWALT Jackson polo shirt is a versatile and comfortable workwear option for trade professionals. Ideal for electricians, plumbers, and general builders, this black polo shirt provides comfort throughout the workday. Manufactured from a durable 96% polyester and 4% spandex blend, it offers excellent breathability and stretch, allowing for unrestricted movement on site. Its lightweight design ensures all-day comfort, while the button funnel neck collar and DEWALT branding on the bound sleeves add a professional finish. This regular fit polo shirt is also machine washable for easy care.
